verdict.rationale: The only evidence that touches time logging is Atlassian naming Tempo Timesheets as one of the Marketplace apps that extend Jira. That makes it an add-on rather than an evidenced native capability, and nothing describes logging time against tasks or projects. Mentions of capacity management and cycle-time measurement do not amount to engineers logging hours. Missing for 10: evidence of native work-logging on issues, project-level time rollups or reporting, documentation of the logging workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
